items.name: Trujillo Open 2025
items.information:
### **IMPORTANTE**
Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo.

* Revisar la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloOpen2025#57557-registro) para conocer los medios de pago.
* Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloOpen2025#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo.
* Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloOpen2025/register)
 
### **IMPORTANT**
  You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament.
  
*  Check [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloOpen2025#57557-registro) to know the payment methods.
*  Check [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloOpen2025#competition-schedule) to know the cronogram.
*   To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrujilloOpen2025/register)

items.name: UCLA Summer 2025
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCLASummer2025#59333-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
